name: Rejuran HB
lead: Rejuran HB is a polynucleotide (PN) injectable used in aesthetic medicine as a skin booster, injected into the skin for a smoother, more hydrated and firmer-looking complexion. One Japanese clinic describes it as combining salmon-derived polynucleotide with hyaluronic acid, with the hyaluronic acid giving an immediate sense of hydration and the polynucleotide behind longer-term changes in firmness and texture.[3] Polynucleotides are chains of nucleotides, and the term covers DNA and RNA, which also have uses beyond cosmetics.[2]

The same clinic distinguishes standard Rejuran (polynucleotide only, aimed at overall skin quality), Rejuran S (a higher concentration, aimed at focused work on scars and uneven areas) and HB (with hyaluronic acid). It says HB may help firmness, pore appearance, fine lines and skin texture by supporting the skin's own collagen and elastin, and that it does not address sagging, deep wrinkles, deep acne scars or pigment spots.[3]

Published research on Rejuran HB itself is limited to a 2026 controlled rabbit study of what happens when polynucleotide products, including Rejuran S, Rejuran HB Plus and Conjuran, are accidentally injected into an artery.[1] No human clinical trial of Rejuran HB was found.

paras: Skin boosters are injectables placed into the skin to improve hydration and quality rather than to add volume to a specific area. Rejuran HB is described by clinics as a polynucleotide booster with added hyaluronic acid, which the clinic says makes injections feel less painful and gives immediate hydration.[3]

One clinic says HB is intended for firmness, pores, fine lines and texture, suggests an initial series of three to four sessions three to four weeks apart followed by maintenance every three to six months, and says firmness and texture changes usually show from the second or third session.[3]

The clinic reports that small bumps at the injection sites usually settle within hours to a day, that bruising, if it occurs, can take about a week to fade and is more likely around the eyes and neck, and that makeup is often allowed the next day.[3]
The clinic lists redness, swelling, bruising, pain, small lumps, infection and allergic reactions, and advises people with fish allergies to disclose this because the ingredient is salmon-derived.[3]

A 2026 rabbit study was motivated by the increasing use of polynucleotide injectables and the need to understand their behaviour if injected into a blood vessel; its findings cannot be directly applied to humans.[1]

No studies found in humans. A 2026 controlled rabbit study in Scientific Reports compared intra-arterial injection of PN products of differing viscosity, including Rejuran S, Rejuran HB Plus and Conjuran, with saline and cross-linked hyaluronic acid, examining arterial flow and cutaneous consequences.[1]

card.summary: A polynucleotide skin-booster injectable with almost no published human data.

quick.overview:
Rejuran HB is a polynucleotide injectable used by clinicians as a skin booster.

The sources reviewed contain no human trials, only a rabbit study on accidental intra-arterial injection.
quick.mechanism: Polynucleotides are chains of nucleotides; skin booster products inject them into the skin. Specific mechanisms for Rejuran HB were not described in the sources reviewed.
quick.risks: The rabbit study examined vascular behaviour of polynucleotide products after intra-arterial exposure; human safety data were not found.

chain: PN plus hyaluronic acid is injected into the skin
Hyaluronic acid hydrates immediately while polynucleotide is said to support collagen and elastin
Skin looks more hydrated, smoother and firmer over a series of sessions
angle.text: Clinics offer Rejuran HB as a skin booster for dull, dry or fine-lined skin, with hydration seen right away and texture and firmness changes described from the second or third session.
